body: Comments are notes tagged comment and linked to the task, note or decision (like handoffs): no new entity.

completion.summary: Comments on tasks, notes and decisions as linked notes (core addComment/listComments, CLI sati comment, MCP note_upsert with tag comment, UI thread open in the task panel and folded on Notes and Decisions, brief shows the newest comment by someone else). MCP task_list short rows unless detail full; search drops rank. A deleted dependency stops blocking. PLAN 7b-7d trimmed; calendar, email/Telegram, link attachments and the token ledger moved to docs/ideas.md.

title: Phase 7a: comments on tasks, notes and decisions
